body.purpose: Wizard instructions, actions and seven fields.

motion.name: loading
motion.purpose: Reading state; reduced motion removes animation/transitions.

wizard.panels: Only one current panel; dedicated loading panel during reading.
wizard.alignment: Automatic quadrilateral projection to 1600 × 1000; user checks orientation and may flip 180 degrees.
wizard.settings: No engine, filter, language or corner controls.
wizard.reuse: Unchanged-photo review reopens edited results without OCR; changes invalidate results, and changing recto clears previous verso.
wizard.verso: Required, decoded, aligned and displayable; no automatic reading or verso template.

fieldOutput.exports: Copy/TXT contain filled fields; JSON retains seven field keys, statuses and provisional profile.
fieldOutput.source: Seven fixed recto value zones in provisional cni_puce_recto_v1, no label search.
fieldOutput.engine: One Paddle TextRecognition instance for seven crops; no automatic Tesseract fallback.
fieldOutput.scope: Old/new classification deferred; no identity/authenticity check or established real-card accuracy.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Advance to the next face or start a new card.

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Back, photo review, or seven-field export.

components.name: Wizard progress
components.description: One active step, indicated semantically and visually.

components.css: .ds-steps{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0 0 24px;display:flex;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font:14px system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-steps li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;flex:1;padding:0 0 18px;color:var(--muted)}.ds-steps li[aria-current]{color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;border-bottom:2px solid var(--accent)}.ds-steps span{width:25px;height:25px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:12px}.ds-steps li[aria-current] span{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent)}@media(max-width:620px){.ds-steps li{font-size:12px;gap:7px}.ds-steps span{width:22px;height:22px}}

narrative.overview: The existing visual identity now supports a sequential Recto, Verso, Results wizard. Paper, white panels, a serif introduction and system controls remain. One active panel guides capture, orientation confirmation and review of seven editable values.

rules.name: Flat work surface
rules.body: Use tone and thin borders without shadows.

dos: Do show one wizard panel and one active progress step at a time.
Do preserve keyboard focus, clear busy/disabled states and explicit preparation errors.
Do keep photo review, field correction and seven-field exports easy to reach.
Do state that the profile is provisional and the verso is captured without automatic reading.
donts: Don’t reintroduce technical settings, free-form OCR output or zone-append controls into this wizard.
Don’t imply automatic card classification, identity verification, trained CNI weights or validated real Paddle accuracy.
Don’t introduce external fonts or decorative shadows.
